description: Election Commission - Declare that a member of the Rideegama Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated A. D. M. B. M. Karunadasa Office of member of the Liberal Party
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the vacation of office by a member of a local authority (Pradeshiya Sabha) due to ceasing membership in a political party. It is published under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, which directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
